name: playwright-bdd-ds-algo-project
description: Playwright BDD automation framework for DS Algo

scripts.clean:reports: rimraf allure-results allure-report playwright-report test-results tests/generated
scripts.test:all: npm run clean:reports && npm run bddgen && playwright test
scripts.test:chromium: npm run clean:reports && npm run bddgen && playwright test --project=chromium
scripts.test:firefox: npm run clean:reports && npm run bddgen && playwright test --project=firefox
scripts.test:webkit: npm run clean:reports && npm run bddgen && playwright test --project=webkit
scripts.test:local:headed: cross-env TEST_ENV=local HEADLESS=false npm run test:all
scripts.test:qa:headed: cross-env TEST_ENV=qa HEADLESS=false npm run test:all
scripts.test:debug: npm run clean:reports && npm run bddgen && playwright test --debug
scripts.test:login: npm run clean:reports && npm run bddgen && playwright test --grep "@TestScenario_login_02"
scripts.test:local:report: cross-env TEST_ENV=local npm run test:all && npm run allure:generate && npm run allure:open
scripts.test:qa:report: cross-env TEST_ENV=qa npm run test:all && npm run allure:generate && npm run allure:open
scripts.test:prod:report: cross-env TEST_ENV=prod npm run test:all && npm run allure:generate && npm run allure:open
